tools.name: find_local_businesses
tools.description: Returns the businesses Google Maps lists for a search in a place: name, address, phone, website, rating, reviews, category and coordinates. One page of up to 20 places per call.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. dentist.

location.description: Where, as plain text, e.g. Tallinn, Estonia.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Returns Google results as rows: web, news or shopping. One query answers at once; several queries (up to 100) start a job.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: search_amazon
tools.description: Returns the products Amazon lists for a search phrase: title, ASIN, price, rating, reviews, image and link.

marketplace.description: Optional Amazon marketplace ending, e.g. com (default), co.uk, de.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: get_amazon_product
tools.description: Returns the data of Amazon product pages: title, brand, price, rating, images, features, variants, ranks and details. Optionally also every seller's offer.

marketplace.description: Optional Amazon marketplace ending for ASINs.

include_offers.description: Optional. true = also read each product's offer listing.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: amazon_seller_leads
tools.description: Builds a lead list of Amazon sellers for a search phrase, with the business contact details each seller published on Amazon. Runs as a job.

keyword.description: Search phrase in the marketplace language.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: idealo_offers
tools.description: Returns the shop offers idealo lists for a product: shop, price, shipping, total, delivery, rating and link for the 20 cheapest offers.

eans_or_urls.description: EAN/GTIN codes or idealo product page addresses, 1-1000.

market.description: Optional idealo market for EAN codes.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: google_trends
tools.description: Returns the Google Trends interest-over-time series (0-100) for one phrase.

geo.description: Optional ISO country code such as US or EE; omit for worldwide.

date.description: Optional range, e.g. today 12-m (default), today 5-y, all.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetches one public web page through a real browser and returns its readable text (default) or HTML.

url.description: The page address, http:// or https://.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: get_product_data
tools.description: Returns the product data a shop publishes on its product pages: name, price, currency, availability, brand, SKU, GTIN/EAN, images, description and rating. All addresses must belong to one shop.

urls.description: Product page addresses of ONE shop, 1-100.

quote_only.description: Optional. true = answer only the price and wallet balance; nothing is charged.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key (max 64 chars); a retry with the same key is answered and charged once.

tools.name: clean_product_data
tools.description: Cleans product rows you already have (free): price in EUR, price per unit, trimming and de-duplication.

to_eur.description: Optional preset: add the price in EUR.

unit_price.description: Optional preset: add the price per unit.

dedupe_by.description: Optional columns identifying a row; first row kept.
